prediction_text: Prediction: Yes — the 2020–2021 period holds a major collective affliction of pandemic kind: a fast-spreading epidemic disease (respiratory in character) reaching pandemic scale in 2020, causing mass illness and death, widespread social restriction and economic disruption, with the severest phase across 2020 and after-effects into 2021. Timing: onset and peak in 2020 (the exact Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction of early 2020 marks the crisis point), unit = year/month scale as the question is framed. The configuration given — five outer planets within ~100 degrees, the Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction, and the cyclical index at its 21st-century low — is read, by the mundane tradition's own parallels (1918, 1954, 1968, 1982 clusters), as a collective-affliction signature, and plague is the affliction class those parallels chiefly carried.
basis:
tradition=western mundane astrology (per card genre: mundane assessment from planetary cycles; configuration supplied in card)
systems_used: western mundane astrology (outer-planet synodic cycles, cyclical index)
Faces in card: main question (major collective affliction 2020–2021); configuration face (Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction early 2020, five outer planets within ~100°, cyclical-index century low); precedent face (comparable clusters coincided with 1918/1954/1968/1982 afflictions). No natal chart is supplied and none is fabricated; the reading rests solely on the supplied configuration and the tradition's stated parallels. Anchor note: the 'lowest cyclical index of the century' anchor is taken at face value (direct reading); its inversion (a low index as merely dormant rather than afflictive) was considered and set aside because the card's own precedent list ties such clusters to affliction years.
